'''Mitsuhisa Tamura''' (Japanese: '''[[:wp:ja:田村光久|田村光久]]'''), born July 17, 1980, is the manga author of the [[Pokémon RéBURST]] manga series. He was also known for co-authoring the [[:wp:Bakegyamon|BakéGyamon]] manga series.
